title: Peaceful Home w/ Big Yard Near Downtown
description:
Make yourself at home in our 3BR/2BA house with huge fully-fenced backyard, private deck, and space to unwind. The home sits on a quiet street in East Nashville known for its many restaurants and bars. Downtown/Broadway, Opryland, and more are within a 15 min drive.

Our home is a great fit for families, friend groups, longer stays, and guests with pets. There are 5 comfortable beds, a well-stocked kitchen, spacious living and dining areas, large TVs, and two full bathrooms with double vanities.

The space
The house has a large, open and bright living room with plenty of seating, a 65" flat screen TV, and a large dining table. Adjacent to the dining area is a beautiful, well-stocked kitchen.

The master bedroom has a queen-size bed, 55" TV, and an ensuite bathroom with double vanity sink and a walk-in shower. The other two bedrooms each have a queen-size bed and a twin XL bed. A second full bathroom off the hallway also features a double vanity sink and a shower-tub combo.

My favorite part of the house is the huge, private backyard! Right off the kitchen is a large elevated deck with outdoor dining table. Stairs lead down to additional patio seating and a very large grass lawn. The backyard is enclosed with a privacy fence.
